record.context_brief: Largest dimension of a linear q-ary code
record.original_question: For fixed code length n, minimum distance d, and finite field F_q, determine k[n, d], the largest integer k ≤ n for which there exists a linear code C contained in F_q^n with dimension k and minimum Hamming weight d.

evidence.quote: Open Question 3.2. For a fixed n, d and Fq, find k[n, d], the largest integer k ≤ n such that there exists a linear code C ⊆ F nq with dim(C) = k and minimum weight d.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q$ be a prime power and let $\mathbb{F}_q$ denote the finite field with $q$ elements. For a vector $x=(x_1,\dots,x_n)\in\mathbb{F}_q^n$, its Hamming weight is $\mathrm{wt}(x)=|\{i:x_i\neq 0\}|$. A linear $[n,k,d]_q$-code is a $k$-dimensional linear subspace $C\subseteq\mathbb{F}_q^n$ whose minimum Hamming weight $\min\{\mathrm{wt}(c):c\in C,\ c\neq 0\}$ equals $d$.

For fixed positive integers $n$ and $d$ with $1\le d\le n$ and a fixed prime power $q$, define
$$k[n,d] := \max\{k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0} : \text{there exists a linear code } C\subseteq\mathbb{F}_q^n \text{ with } \dim_{\mathbb{F}_q} C=k \text{ and minimum weight } d\}.$$

Problem: Determine $k[n,d]$ as a function of $n$, $d$, and $q$.
artifact.status_search_result: Determining the maximum dimension of a linear code with prescribed length, minimum distance, and field size is a long-standing fundamental problem in coding theory. While bounds (Singleton, Hamming, Griesmer, Plotkin, linear programming) and many specific values are known, no general closed-form solution exists. Recent work continues to determine optimal parameters for restricted cases (e.g., small dimension or specific field sizes), confirming the problem remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: On the minimum length of linear codes of dimension 5
status_evidence.snippet: Determining optimal linear codes for given parameters remains an active research problem, with recent advances only for restricted dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: The general problem of optimal linear code parameters remains open; recent results only address specific small cases.

status_evidence.title: Construction of linear codes with large minimum distance
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions and tables of best-known linear codes are continually updated, with many parameter regimes still unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Tables of best known linear codes show many gaps between upper and lower bounds, indicating the problem is unresolved in general.
